name: Buea

attempts.route: Cameroon Geoportal landing page and current JavaScript bundle
attempts.outcome: Loaded the public bilingual portal and followed its current bundle to https://api.geoportal.cam and the advertised GeoServer URL https://gs.geoportal.cm/geoserver. No cadastral parcel dataset was named in the 109-item catalogue; only general boundaries/land-use data were relevant.
Returned JSON catalogue count 109. Search of IDs/titles for parcel, cadastral, land, plot, foncier and parcelle found no parcel/cadastre dataset. Relevant land-use results are not parcel geometry.

DNS resolution failed for gs.geoportal.cm from this environment. No service availability or empty-result claim is inferred. The bundle's proxy-like /cameroon/wfs route was also attempted on api.geoportal.cam and returned HTTP 404 Not Found.

attempts.route: Official MINDCAF site and public documents
attempts.outcome: Official national ministry site loaded. It provides agency/procedure context, not a public anonymous Buea parcel API. The public documents page also loaded at https://mindcaf.gov.cm/fr/docs/.
attempts.safeFieldPolicy: No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, account or personal fields requested.

attempts.outcome: Official Buea Council website loaded; no cadastral viewer or public parcel endpoint identified in the fetched page.

Official Buea municipality Land Use Plan located. It is a planning/zoning document and was not treated as cadastral parcel geometry. A related land-use regulation PDF was also found at https://www.minhdu.gov.cm/minhduetude/public/downloaddoc?pathdoc=%2Fvar%2Fwww%2Fdocuments%2F83%2FDocs%2FLand-use-reglementation.pdf.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only, if a first-party parcel response is later verified
scopeLimits: No parcel geometry was returned, so no GeoJSON sample was retained.
The exact WUP point was not shifted and was not used as evidence of citywide absence.
Portal catalogue and endpoint failures do not establish that no cadastral data exists elsewhere or behind a non-public service.
National MINDCAF authority/procedure evidence is distinct from a verified local Buea registry or parcel map.
Runtime readiness remains held pending independent serial qualification of a real parcel adapter.
uncertainty: The Cameroon Geoportal is a real public national geospatial portal, but its currently exposed catalogue did not include cadastral parcels and its advertised GeoServer host was not resolvable here. A Buea land-use plan and official council site establish planning/local-authority context only. No city-specific parcel identity, schema, CRS response, or geometry was verified.
